engine: 11tanjung's plans carousel — a row of landscape cards on a track that translateX one STEP at a time, with EDGE-PEEK (the next card's edge shows past the active one). A VERTICAL-PILL arrow sits in the gap (next / prev); each card carries its own CTA-pill; and a SPEC-ROW (title / sqft / rooms) swaps SYNCHRONOUSLY with the active card. Driven by the arrows, drag, wheel or keyboard. Harvested from D_11tanjung (C5).

measured_teardown.move: the track translateX(-index * step)px where step = card width + gap. Each card is flex 0 0 calc((100% - gap) * (1 - peek)) so it fills (1-peek) of the viewport and the next card peeks at the edge. The active card is opacity 1, the neighbours dimmed (~.55). On index change the spec-row fields (data-title/data-sqft/data-rooms) crossfade to the active card's values and the active CTA-pill fades + lifts in. ease ~cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1) ~520ms. Arrows disable at the ends (non-loop).
measured_teardown.cited: 11tanjung C5: translateX slides of landscape cards + a vertical-pill arrow in the gap + a per-card CTA-pill + a spec-row (title/sqft/rooms) that swaps synchronously + edge-peek of the next. drag / arrow / scroll.

peek.what: fraction of a card left visible as the edge-peek — the next card's edge shows this much past the active one. 0.16 = ~17% peek (the 11tanjung look).

ease.what: the slide curve — a soft overshoot-free ease-out (expo-ish). Also drives the active-opacity fade.

wheel.what: advance on horizontal wheel intent (or shift+wheel); one step per gesture (locked for `duration`).

drag.what: pointer drag / swipe to advance (>40px throw = step, else snap back).

loop.what: wrap past the ends; when false the prev/next arrows disable at the first/last card.

entry: HorizontalSpecCarousel.create(target, opts) -> { go(i), next(), prev(), index(), count, destroy }. target = .hsc-stage with .hsc-viewport > .hsc-track > .hsc-card[data-title][data-sqft][data-rooms] (each may hold .hsc-cta) + .hsc-spec(.hsc-spec-title/-sqft/-rooms) + .hsc-prev/.hsc-next (the vertical-pill arrows) + optional .hsc-dot list. go(i) animates to a card; the spec-row + CTA + dots follow.
law: transform: translateX (track) + opacity (spec crossfade, CTA, dimmed neighbours) only; GPU; NO mix-blend / NO backdrop over the cards; NO WebGL; reduced-motion -> instant index (no slide). owns_pin false, owns_scroll false (a triggered carousel — arrows/drag/wheel/keyboard, not a scroll-pin). Keyboard: the stage is focusable, Left/Right step.
gate_mode: triggered (arrows / drag / wheel / keyboard), NOT scroll. Verify: translateX step = cardW + gap; edge-peek (cardW ~= vpW*(1-peek)); the spec-row title/sqft/rooms track the active card; CTA shows on the active; arrows disable at the ends (non-loop). Smoothness via the TRIGGERED variant of the probe (arm the meter, then click next/prev repeatedly), not the wheel-scroll variant.
proven: lab: 4 plan cards on OUR QUADRO renders (terrace-02 / day-front / terrace-04 / aerial). Measured live: idx0 tx=0 spec='Таунхаус A / 82 м²' prevDisabled; next -> idx1 tx=-1044 spec='Таунхаус B / 94 м²'; at last -> idx3 tx=-3132 spec='Пентхаус-рівень / 126 м²' nextDisabled; prev -> idx2 spec='Кутова секція / 108 м²'; dot->0 returns. step = 1044px = cardW 1020 + gap 24; cardW 1020 in vpW 1238 => ~17.6% edge-peek (matches peek 0.16). Active card opacity 1, neighbours dimmed. Triggered probe (4x CPU throttle, cycling next/prev x4): 2/439 long frames (0.5%), 59.9fps -> PASS. Zero console errors.
